epistemic_gaps: This was an observational study, meaning it can report an association but cannot establish that running itself caused the longer lifespans.
headline_claim: Just five minutes of running a day adds three years to your life.
primary_claim: Runners had roughly 30 percent lower all-cause mortality and about 45 percent lower cardiovascular mortality, and lived on average about three years longer compared to non-runners, with benefits observed even among those who ran only 5 to 10 minutes a day at slow speeds.
